# Old Town, Lightly — Edinburgh

2026-09-14 – 2026-09-16 · 3 traveler(s) · relaxed pace

## Assumptions

- Assumed the mid-range budget applies to attraction tickets, not accommodation — traveler confirmed the hotel is already booked but didn't specify a separate ticket budget.

## Day 1 — Old Town (2026-09-14)

Everything today sits within Old Town, a short walk from the hotel —
deliberately chosen to minimize backtracking per the accommodation
constraint. Castle first while queues are shorter, a relaxed walk down
the Royal Mile, and Camera Obscura in the afternoon as a lighter,
interactive stop that works well for a 6-year-old.

**Estimated walk:** 2.1 km · **Intensity:** light

| Time | Stop | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30–11:30 | Edinburgh Castle | required — book: https://example.com/edinburgh-castle-tickets |
| 11:45–13:00 | Royal Mile | not_needed |
| 14:00–15:30 | Camera Obscura & World of Illusions | recommended — book: https://example.com/camera-obscura-tickets — last entry 18:00 |

**Getting there:** Hotel → Edinburgh Castle (walk, ~10 min) · Edinburgh Castle → Royal Mile (walk, ~2 min) · Royal Mile → lunch stop (walk, ~5 min) · lunch stop → Camera Obscura (walk, ~5 min) · Camera Obscura → Hotel (walk, ~8 min)

**Nearby meal options:** Royal Mile — many casual family-friendly cafes, a candidate, not a fixed booking

## Day 2 — Holyrood Park / Southside (2026-09-15)

A lighter day built around Arthur's Seat and the National Museum of
Scotland. The summit ascent is skipped in favor of the shorter Dunsapie
Loch viewpoint path, given the family's stamina constraint, and the
museum's free, unhurried, indoor format works as a natural afternoon
wind-down — and a rain backup, per the soft weather constraint.

**Estimated walk:** 3.0 km · **Intensity:** light

| Time | Stop | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30–10:30 | Arthur's Seat (Dunsapie Loch viewpoint path) | not_needed |
| 12:00–14:30 | National Museum of Scotland | not_needed |

**Getting there:** Hotel → Arthur's Seat (Dunsapie Loch) (taxi, ~10 min) · Arthur's Seat (Dunsapie Loch) → lunch stop (walk, ~15 min) · lunch stop → National Museum of Scotland (bus, ~12 min) · National Museum of Scotland → Hotel (walk, ~10 min)

**Nearby meal options:** Holyrood / Southside — casual lunch near Holyrood Park before heading to the museum

## Day 3 — Inverleith (2026-09-16)

A short, low-key morning at the Royal Botanic Garden before collecting
luggage and heading to Waverley for the 16:00 train — deliberately
unscheduled after 11:30 to leave slack for a delay or a tired child,
rather than planning right up to departure.

**Estimated walk:** 1.8 km · **Intensity:** light

| Time | Stop | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30–11:30 | Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh | not_needed |

**Getting there:** Hotel → Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh (bus, ~15 min) · Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh → Hotel (bus, ~15 min) · Hotel → Edinburgh Waverley station (taxi, ~10 min)

**Nearby meal options:** Stockbridge, near the Botanic Garden — relaxed cafe options for a final lunch before departure
